description: Default NVIDIA Gr00t N1.5 3B fine-tuning configuration (so100_dualcam data config, 6000 steps, single GPU).
inputInstructions:
Fine-tunes the GR00T-N1.5-3B model on a LeRobot dataset stored in the asset. Runs on a GPU and takes a substantial amount of time; the resulting checkpoint is written back to the asset in a gr00tOutput_* folder.

Asset metadata this pipeline reads (all optional):
  GROOT_DATASET_PATH          Folder within the asset holding the LeRobot dataset.
  GROOT_DATA_CONFIG           Named data configuration describing the robot's cameras and joints.
  GROOT_BASE_MODEL_PATH       Base model to fine-tune from.
  GROOT_EMBODIMENT_TAG        Embodiment tag recorded in the checkpoint.
  GROOT_VIDEO_BACKEND         Video decoder used to read the dataset's episodes.
  GROOT_MAX_STEPS             Training steps to run.
  GROOT_BATCH_SIZE            Samples per step.
  GROOT_LEARNING_RATE         Optimizer learning rate.
  GROOT_WEIGHT_DECAY          Optimizer weight decay.
  GROOT_WARMUP_RATIO          Fraction of steps spent warming up the learning rate.
  GROOT_SAVE_STEPS            How often a checkpoint is written.
  GROOT_NUM_GPUS              GPUs to train across.
  GROOT_LORA_RANK             LoRA rank; 0 means full fine-tuning rather than LoRA.
  GROOT_LORA_ALPHA            LoRA alpha.
  GROOT_LORA_DROPOUT          LoRA dropout.
  GROOT_TUNE_LLM              Whether to tune the language backbone.
  GROOT_TUNE_VISUAL           Whether to tune the vision backbone.
  GROOT_TUNE_PROJECTOR        Whether to tune the action-head projector.
  GROOT_TUNE_DIFFUSION_MODEL  Whether to tune the action-head diffusion model.

How to supply metadata: set these as metadata on the ASSET (Metadata tab on the asset page, or `vamscli metadata create`). Keys are case-sensitive.

Precedence: this template's configuration WINS over GROOT_* asset metadata. Metadata is a per-asset default for anything the configuration does not set.
